Info

Defines structural protocol IStreamStepDispatcher for single step dispatch.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.worker.ascii.istream_step_dispatcher.IStreamStepDispatcher(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural protocol defining single step transmission operations.

It defines:

methods:
can_dispatch_step - Checks if next step can be transmitted.
dispatch_step - Transmits next step and updates counters.
